task.description:
Design and write tests for API-01 REST conventions (RFC 9457 Problem Details + Content-Type enforcement).

Produce:
1. A test spec at tests/specs/API-01.md covering all acceptance criteria
2. Unit test code at tests/unit/api_conventions_test.zig

Test cases MUST cover:

**ProblemDetails (errors.zig):**
- problemBadRequest produces status=400, type URI contains 'bad-request'
- problemNotFound produces status=404
- problemConflict produces status=409
- problemUnprocessable produces status=422
- problemUnsupportedMediaType produces status=415
- problemInternalError produces status=500
- problemServiceUnavailable produces status=503
- serializeToJson outputs valid JSON with all 4 RFC 9457 fields (type, title, status, detail)
- serializeToJson JSON contains correct status numeric value

**Content-Type middleware (content_type.zig):**
- POST with Content-Type: application/json → null (pass)
- POST with Content-Type: text/plain → 415 ProblemDetails
- POST with no Content-Type → 415 ProblemDetails
- PUT with Content-Type: application/json and body → null (pass)
- PUT with no body → 400 ProblemDetails
- GET (no body expected) → null (pass, Content-Type not checked)
- DELETE (no body expected) → null (pass)
- PATCH with Content-Type: application/json → null (pass)
- PATCH with wrong Content-Type → 415 ProblemDetails

**Response helpers (response.zig):**
- ok() returns status_code=200
- created() returns status_code=201
- noContent() returns status_code=204 and empty body
- problemResponse() returns correct status_code matching ProblemDetails.status

Note: These are unit tests (pure functions, no DB, no HTTP server needed).
Add the test file to build.zig so it is compiled by `zig build test`.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/API-01.md exists with all AC mapped to test cases
tests/unit/api_conventions_test.zig exists with all test cases listed above
Test file is wired into build.zig
zig build test exits 0 after adding the test file

result.summary: Test spec and unit tests for API-01 (RFC 9457 Problem Details + Content-Type enforcement + response helpers). 22 test cases across 3 modules. Fixed std.mem.trimRight -> trimEnd bug in content_type.zig (Zig 0.16 API change). zig build test exits 0.

issues.description: content_type.zig used std.mem.trimRight which does not exist in Zig 0.16; fixed to std.mem.trimEnd. File was not previously compiled in any build step.
